description: This file contains a static helper class 'FontHelper' providing methods to load font data from embedded resources or WPF Pack URI resources within the PdfSharp.Quality namespace.

classes.name: FontHelper
classes.description: A static class providing methods for loading font data from embedded resources or WPF resource URIs.

methods.name: LoadFontData
methods.description: Loads font data bytes from an embedded resource by name, using the assembly of FontHelper.

methods.name: LoadFontData
methods.description: Loads font data bytes from an embedded resource given its name and assembly.

methods.name: LoadFontDataPack
methods.description: Loads font data bytes from a WPF Pack URI resource.
